inputs.goal: cover the 110-page contained sci-fi thriller against a low-budget mandate

read.synopsis: A group of strangers awaken to find themselves trapped in an abandoned building with no memory of how they got there. As food and supplies dwindle, they must unravel the mystery behind their imprisonment while trying to survive against each other.

beats.detail: Strangers awaken in an abandoned building.
Characters start forming alliances and suspect each other.
Discovery of the truth behind their imprisonment.

rationale: The story follows a three-act structure with clear turning points.
However, the pacing is rushed in the first act and the second act lacks subplots to build tension.
All key events happen on even Act page numbers; consider staggering

structure_analysis.firstActAnalysis: First act feels rushed; needs pacing adjustments and more scene development on odd-numbered pages.
structure_analysis.secondActAnalysis: Second act lacks tension-building subplots; needs more interruptions to the main conflict
structure_analysis.pageBalancing: Key events are all at even page numbers, which feels too formulaic for a low-budget film

firstAct.action: Introduce first memory flashback to slow pacing
Add scene with partial resource discovery

thirdAct.action: Add moment of unexpected revelation about one character's past

proposed_budget_reductions.suggestion: Use minimal set pieces and focus on practical lighting effects
Limit to essential crew members only

rationale: The story has potential with its contained setting and suspenseful premise.
